name: Sika AnchorFix Flexible Extensions
paste:
SIKA ANCHORFIX® FLEXIBLE EXTENSIONS: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika AnchorFix® Flexible Extensions, April 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/t/sika-anchorfix-flexibleextensions.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika AnchorFix® Flexible Extensions where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. Sika AnchorFix® Flexible Extensions is a flexible tube and used as an extension of the nozzle / static mixer to apply AnchorFix® into deep drill holes.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. AnchorFix® static mixer / nozzle extension

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika AnchorFix® Flexible Extensions
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: AnchorFix Flexible Extension For Nozzle
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates. Flexible extensions are referenced in the corresponding approvals of each Sika AnchorFix® product
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Easy to use
    - For all AnchorFix® applications
    - Cut to length
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Transparent
2.5 Dimensions. Dimensions flexible extensions:
    | Ø Diameter (Outer) | Ø Diameter (Inner) | Length |
    | 9 mm | 6 mm | 1000 mm |
    | 9 mm | 6mm | 300 mm |
2.6 System structure. Ancillary products:
    - Sika AnchorFix® Static Mixer / Nozzle
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Bag of 2 pieces with 1000 mm length tube; Bag of 5 pieces with 300 mm length tube; Bag of 10 pieces with 300 mm length tube
    - Shelf life: Unlimited
    - Storage conditions: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions. Always refer to packaging.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application method / tools. Depending on the drill hole depth required. Place extension tube over the end of the static mixer / nozzle. Extension tube can be cut to the required length.
4.3 Cleaning of equipment. Once used Sika AnchorFix® Flexible Extensions cannot be cleaned
4.4 Further information.
    - Product data sheets: Sika AnchorFix® products
    - Application video: Sika AnchorFix® products
    - Approvals: Sika AnchorFix® products

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika AnchorFix® Flexible Extensions, April 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/t/sika-anchorfix-flexibleextensions.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. REGULATION (EC) NO 1907/2006 - REACH This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
